main_text.p: ion fatis inter omnes convenit ; neque rofecto videtur ifti problemati una af- firmatione fimpliciter & fufficienter re- ponderi poffe , cum judicium hac in parte pendeat plurimum ex circumftan- tiis. Sed utcunque, eft ea quæftio non ujus inftituti. Evincit ratio dubitati- nis expedire , ne quis aut ebrius aut atus quidquam omnino juret : quia illa mentis intemperie non poteft ju- are in judicio ; fed neceffe eft ut id te- nere effutiat quicquid demum id fit , uod fuaferint ( quæ nil moderabile fua- ent) vinum & dolor, quodque fanus & ccus indictum injuratumque magno re- emptum cuperet. Sed tamen de Obli- atione diftinguendum eft. Nam primo, ut res illicita eft in quam juravit, aut cita & honefta. Si illicita fuerit ( ut lerunq; fit in his præfertim juramentis uæ iratis nimia vindictæ cupiditate ob- ecatis ex animo quodam impetu exci- unt) manifeftum eft non obligare : i enim illicitæ nullam effe obligatio- em ante demonftratum eft fatis. page.notes: The left edge of the scan is cropped, so the first letter of several lines is partly cut off (e.g. "ion", "rofecto", "ujus", "nis", "are"); these are transcribed as far as visible. Lines beginning "ion fatis", "rofecto", "ponderi" and similar are clipped at the margin and may need checking against the original. The final word "inter-" is a hyphenated line-end, continuing on the next page. No catchword is printed. Running head and page number are as printed.
